correctness.rationale: At λ=λ_m, m full branches map onto [0,1]; the terminal branch maps exactly to I0 for even m and I1..Im for odd m. Removing one full lap gives a finite sub-Markov matrix and exact Lebesgue survival S_j(n)=λ^{-(n−1)}1ᵀA_j^{n−1}ℓ_j. Hole j>=1 matrices are permutation-similar; the terminal-row entry for leftmost hole reverses with parity and gives a strict inequality for all n>=2. For the other holes the 2-coordinate Perron equations are r²−(m−1)r−1=0 (even) or r²−mr+1=0 (odd); for hole0 roots are m−1 or m. Branch cylinder counting, PF growth and standard expanding Markov Frostman arguments establish escape rates, entropy and dimension, including m=2 root1. Independently constructed A_j for m=2..17 and computed roots, and full finite survival ranking for 144 (m,n) pairs, n=2..10.
residual_risks: Finite row checks alone do not prove all horizons; entropy and Hausdorff claims require surviving recurrent symbolic component and standard Markov boundary control.
